title: HB0395 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 44, Chapter 17 and Title 70, Chapter 4, Part 1, relative to the possession of firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Chaptered, 2023-05-01; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 2798214)
provenance.note: Chaptered, Public Chapter 218 (approved 2023-05-01), printed as Senate Bill 494 substituted for House Bill 395; the law as enacted. SECTIONS 1 and 2 add the quoted clause to 70-4-103(b) and 70-4-112(a)(1) (a clause added 'immediately before the period'); SECTION 3 (70-4-112(a)(2)(A)) restates the raccoon-dog training rule with the same handgun exception. SECTIONS 7-8 only change 'coon' to 'raccoon'.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 70-4-103(b)): ; except that, a person who is not otherwise prohibited by law from possessing a handgun may carry a handgun as defined in § 39-11-106, so long as the handgun is not used for the taking of game
SECTION 4 (TCA 70-4-117(d)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 70-4-117(d), is amended by deleting "with a handgun carry permit pursuant to § 39-17-1351 may possess a handgun" and substituting "not otherwise prohibited by law from possessing a handgun may carry a handgun as defined in § 39-11-106".
SECTION 5 (TCA 70-4-117(e)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 70-4-117(e), is amended by deleting "with a hand gun carry permit" and substituting "not otherwise prohibited by law from possessing a handgun".
SECTION 6 (TCA 70-4-123(a)): It is unlawful for a person hunting big game with a bow and arrow to be in possession of a firearm or be accompanied in hunting by a person possessing a firearm during the archery-only deer season; except that, a person who is not otherwise prohibited by law from possessing a handgun may carry a handgun as defined in § 39-11-106, so long as the handgun is not used for the taking of game.
